3-5 years Experience supervising or leading a team of security professionals in a hospital setting or similar law enforcement experience.
Hospital Security Experience.

As a member of the UC Irvine Police Department, the Site Public Safety Supervisor supervises and directs a team of Public Safety Supervisors and Responders in monitoring and responding to public Safety concerns and conditions at one of four UCI Health Community Network Hospitals: Placentia, Lakewood, Los Alamitos and Fountain Valley.

Reporting to a Police Sergeant, the Site Public Safety Supervisor has overall responsibility for supervising and monitoring Public Safety team members assigned to a Community Network Hospital, providing public safety services and ensuring program standards and policies are adhered to.
Must be able to read, write, and speak English.
In the event of an emergency, this position is required to "report to duty" in accordance with the Police Department and University Emergency Operations Plan.
Must be able to monitor and effectively use public safety alarms, radios, and video surveillance systems.
Must complete all training required for this position.
Completion of PC 832 Powers to Arrest or a California POST Basic Peace Officer Acadmey.
Completion of FEMA ICS 100, ICS 200, IS 700 and IS 800 courses.
Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply regulations as issues arise.

Knowledge of organization, HR and UC policies and processes. Knowledge of relevant regulatory agencies federal and state requirements. Ability to apply policy knowledge to identify compliance risks and regulatory issues.

Demonstrated leadership skills in training, mentoring, and guiding employees. Actively cooperates and supports the work of others. Holds self and others accountable. Motivates and inspires staff to improve services.
Ability to pass a Livescan, modified Police Officer Background and Physical Examination.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively to meet deadlines in a fast paced environment.
Ability to organize assigned staff and unit operations in an efficient and effective manner.
Ability to develop and maintain cooperative working relationships with the Public Safety Team and collaborate across departments, and liaison effectively with external partners as necessary.
Skills to quickly evaluate issues, apply judgment on the spot, and identify solutions within defined procedures and policies.

Interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and/or stressful situations with others to achieve common goals. Customer service orientation to quickly address questions or issues. Excellent communication skills to explain the reasoning behind security policies to staff and the broader population.

Must be able to demonstrate good decision-making skills and judgment when interacting with the public as well as during critical and high-stress incidents that may include medical and mental health crises and emergency situations.
